In cellular models, CPT1C promotes protrudin-dependent transfer of kinesin-1 to FYCO1-positive late endosomes/lysosomes under nutrient-replete conditions. CPT1C deficiency or low malonyl-CoA impairs peripheral organelle delivery. CPT1C-protrudin binding persists under stress, and CPT1C does not create the ER-lysosome contacts themselves. R37C-specific motor-transfer impairment remains inferred.
